NAME: Timers and watchdog verification plan
details: Block 11: timers_top with mtime, wdt and timers_apb. Source: GARUDA-TIMERS-SPEC-001 and decisions D-16, D-17. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md. Groups A, B, C and E are checked in the block environment tb/timers/uvm (make uvm_timers); group D needs the core and is checked at chip level.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 11, 0x4000_B000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 MTIME_LO reads the low word and latches the high word
details: Offset 0x00, read-write, reset 0. A read returns mtime[31:0] and in the same hclk cycle copies mtime[63:32] into the shadow. A write sets mtime[31:0]. Spec 6, [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model, scoreboard). Before the UVM environment: tb_timers [N-7.5]. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_mtime
details: The reference model counts hclk cycles; every MTIME_LO read is compared with the model at the cycle of the read strobe.
implementation_note: tmr_scoreboard in tb/timers/uvm/timers_env_pkg.sv, against tmr_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: cg_tmr_apb.cp_reg MTIME_LO
details: Bins - read, write.
implementation_note: tmr_coverage in tb/timers/uvm/timers_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F02 MTIME_HI reads the shadow and writes the high word
details: Offset 0x04, read-write, reset 0. A read returns the shadow latched by the last MTIME_LO read, never the live upper word. A write sets mtime[63:32]. Spec 6, [N-7.5], [N-7.6].
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_timers [N-7.5] in the LO-then-HI order only. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_hi_returns_shadow
details: A read of MTIME_HI returns the shadow register.
